newsitem.title: UK: Rank to sell Rank Xerox stake for 1 bln stg.
newsitem.headline: Rank to sell Rank Xerox stake for 1 bln stg.

text.p: British leisure company Rank Group Plc said on Friday it was to sell its remaining 20 percent stake in office equipment joint venture Rank Xerox to Xerox Corporation for a total of up to one billion pounds ($1.6 billion).
Rank also said it intended to repurchase its own shares up to a maximum value of 250 million pounds.
Rank said it had signed a letter of intent on the deal, which is subject to a definitive agreement.

Xerox will pay 500 million pounds ($812.6 million) on completion of the transaction, expected to take place at the end of June. The balance will be payable in two annual instalments of 220 million pounds. Xerox may pay a further 60 million pounds in 2000, based on profit performance.
Rank said the sale was expected to have a broadly neutral effect on its earnings per share this year.

The company said it expected a share buyback later this year and would use the balance of the initial consideration to cut debt and invest in its leisure and entertainment businesses. ($ = 0.615 British Pounds)
